question: What did Apple spend on R&D and SG&A, and how did that change relative to revenue?

answer.summary: The retrieved evidence does not contain Apple's R&D or SG&A spending figures for FY2023 or any prior period; these expense lines are not in the retrieved evidence, so the question cannot be answered from this material. What is available is revenue context: total net sales were $383.29B in FY2023 [F00013], down 2.8% YoY from $394.33B in FY2022 [F00014], after rising 7.8% in FY2022 [F00014]. The FY2023 revenue decline was driven primarily by Mac (-$10.82B, 98% of the total change) [F00282] and by the Americas business segment (-$7.10B, 64% of the total change) [F00838], partially offset by Services (+$7.07B) [F00010]. Management text attributes the full-year decrease to foreign currency weakness and lower Mac and iPhone sales, partially offset by higher Services [T00275].
